data.text:
Happy 14th anniversary to the chart-topping, record-breaking, history-making, top-selling legendary Band #EXO, who rang in their anniversary, trending at #3 Worldwide on X with #EXO14thanniversary, at #4 with #14YearsWithEXO and at #6 with 14 YEARS ON EXO PLANET and still counting! 👏🎂🎉🌟🐐💥3⃣, 4⃣&6⃣🌎✖️👑👑👑👑👑👑👑👑👑💙
EXO exploded onto the international scene, boasting one of the strongest vocal lineups in K-pop history, famous for their powerful, emotionally rich voices! They rewrote K-pop history, becoming the 1st Korean act in over a decade to smash a Million album sales with their history-making 1st studio album 'XOXO' and its "Growl" repackage, and became quintuple then septuple million sellers, hitting 10 million+ cumulative sales as the first 21st-century group to do so, now at over 16 million sales on the Circle Chart alone. They won 5 straight Album of the Year Daesangs at the prestigious Mnet Asian Music Awards, racking up 23 Grand Prizes in total and a Guinness World Record for the Most Daesangs among K-Pop Acts in history, and stormed past 100 music show wins, the most for a K-Pop Male Act, dropping chart-topping bangers all the way, while selling out arenas in record-shattering seconds! EXO has performed over 100 concerts across 4 world tours and multiple joint tours. Even in 2026 with 'REVERXE', EXO proved why they're one of the most decorated, best-selling forces in the game, having paved the way for many! 

Exo's first studio album 'XOXO' was released in June 2013 and received various awards, including their first Daesang award. The album won Album of the Year at the 2013 Mnet Asian Music Awards and Disc Daesang at the 2014 Golden Disc Awards with its smash hit single "Growl" winning Song of the Year at the 2013 Melon Music Awards! Exo's 6th studio album, 'Don't Mess Up My Tempo' (2018), became their highest-charting album on the US Billboard 200, debuting at No. 23! Their 8th studio album, 'Exist' (2023), became their best-selling album in South Korea, surpassing 2 million units! Exo have continued receiving awards and nominations for their record-breaking albums, accumulating 23 Daesang awards including 5 consecutive Album of the Year wins at the Mnet Asian Music Awards, 4 consecutive Disc Daesang wins at the Golden Disc Awards, 4 consecutive Daesang wins at the Seoul Music Awards, and two consecutive Artist of the Year wins at the Melon Music Awards!

EXO has won over 180 awards from 324 nominations including 23 Seoul Music Awards, 18 Golden Disc Awards, 17 MelON Music awards including 2 consecutive Artist of the Year awards, 16 MAMA Awards including 6 Daesangs (5 consecutive Album of the Year awards and Artist of the Year in 2024), 16 Gaon Music Awards, 8 Asia Artist Awards, 7 Philippine K-Pop Awards, 6 V chart Awards, 6 Asian Pop Music Awards, 4 top Chinese Music awards, 4 Soribada Best K-Music Awards, 4 V Live Awards, a Billboard Music Festival Award for Most popular Group, a Hanteo Music Award, a Baidu Music Award, a Chinese Music Award, an MTV Europe Music Award and a Tencent Music Award! EXO were the 1st Korean Act with BIGBANG to win a World Music Award. In 2014 they were honoured with the Awards for Best-selling Korean Act and World's Best Song voted by the public! The band have won over 100 music program awards cumulatively, becoming the second act to do so after their label-mates Girls' Generation! On November 3, 2017, Exo received a Prime Minister Commendation at the Korean Popular Culture and Arts Awards, an honor bestowed in recognition of public service and/or excellence in a given field! EXO was ranked by Forbes on their Korea Power Celebrity list as the most powerful celebrities in South Korea in 2015 and 2016 and one of the top 5 most influential celebrities on the Forbes Korea Power Celebrity 40 list in 2024, 2017 and 2018, and were named "Nation's Pick" by the Korea Tourism Organization and by some as the "Kings of K-pop"!

EXO group members are all Top Models and Fashion Icons, and have modelled for some of the top designers in the world and been endorsed by many top global brands! 

EXO has quietly built a strong legacy of charity, with SM Entertainment donating over 1.2 billion won through the Smile for U program with UNICEF to bring music education to underprivileged children in Vietnam and the Philippines. The group donated all profits from their 2017 collab “Dancing King” (32 million won) to the Beautiful Foundation to support youth leaving orphanages, while individual members have given tens of millions each year to children’s hospitals, scholarships, hearing-impaired kids, wildfire relief and in 2025 they donated HK$500,000 via the Korean Red Cross to support relief and reconstruction efforts for victims of the major tower fire in Hong Kong.
They excel in consistent, low-key giving that matches their powerhouse image!

From a 12-member rookie group debuting in 2012 with the modest mini-album 'Mama', EXO has come incredibly far, shattering All Time records, becoming the first 21st-century Asian act to hit 10 million cumulative sales. Through lineup changes, military service, and shifting trends, they’ve delivered consistent dominance, scoring multiple Daesangs, sold-out world tours, and a powerful 2026 comeback with “Crown” sweeping music show grand slams, proving their legacy only grows stronger after 14 years.

14 YEARS ON EXO PLANET 
#14YearsWithEXO 
#EXO14thAnniversary 
#OurUniverseCalledEXO
@weareoneEXO
